title: Accounting, Tax and Finance Support for SMEs
menuText: Books, filings and MIS for owner-led businesses
summary: Books, filings and a clear monthly picture for owner-led businesses, with a named accountant behind every deliverable.
metaTitle: SME Accounting, Tax and Payroll Outsourcing
metaDescription: Outsourced accounting, GST, VAT, payroll and MIS for SMEs in India and the GCC. A named accountant, books closed by the 7th and compliance on autopilot.
heroHeading: Your finance function, run for you.
heroIntro: SMEs need accurate books and on-time filings more than a finance department. We keep both running, so you can run the business.

challenges.title: Owner as accountant
challenges.text: Month-ends and filings fall on the owner or one overstretched employee.

challenges.title: Missed deadlines
challenges.text: Several registrations on different calendars, with penalties for slips.

challenges.title: No clear picture
challenges.text: Numbers arrive late and in a form that is hard to act on.

howWeHelp.title: Monthly rhythm
howWeHelp.text: Bills in on WhatsApp, books closed by the 7th, MIS delivered, filings completed ahead of due dates.

howWeHelp.title: Compliance on autopilot
howWeHelp.text: A calendar for each registration and a confirmation once it is filed.

howWeHelp.title: Payroll handled
howWeHelp.text: Statutory payroll to local rules, with payslips by email or WhatsApp.

howWeHelp.title: Your software, your data
howWeHelp.text: We work in the accounting system you own, so data and history stay with you.

faqs.q: We have an in-house bookkeeper. Can you still help?
faqs.a: Yes. We can review and close the books, handle compliance and reporting, and support your bookkeeper with a named accountant and a review checklist.
